lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lip fold (base top skin to lip outer face), about 90.6 deg, on the outer-skin apex. Sections at 25/50/75% put the ring on the top of the outer arc. Measured outer-apex offset along the line is -0.33 to +0.12 mm, with the extremum within 0.5 mm laterally. The line runs the full 373 mm edge; apex points start at s=-2 and end at s=373, so the fold stops within about 2 mm of each line end. The rounded lip-end corners and the patch-20 strip are lip faces, not folds.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Tall end flange 3/4 fold, about 90.4 deg, outer-skin pair 2|3. The ring sits on the outer-arc apex in all three sections (offset -0.05 to +0.18 mm). Apex points cover s=-1 to 44 against a 45.3 mm line. The line stops at the flange-edge notch on one side and at the relief by the lip corner on the other. The flange part that overhangs past the base edge is not part of the fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Inclined tall end flange 5/6, about 110 deg bend (70 deg included), large radius. The line sits on the outer (upper) arc apex, not on the inner-skin pair, in the 25/50/75% sections (offset -0.14 to +0.29 mm). Apex points cover s=-1 to 44 against a 43.4 mm line, ending at the notch/relief. Patches 15, 16, 18 and 19 are bend-radius strips of this same fold.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Tab 9/10 fold, about 90 deg. The outer arc is only partly scanned on the base side, but the ring sits at the top of the outer arc about 1.8-1.9 mm (one thickness) outside the inner-arc apex. Offset is -0.01 to +0.06 mm. Apex points cover s=-1 to 47 against a 47.4 mm line, from the slanted base end edge to the relief notch.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Tab 11/12 fold, about 65.5 deg bend (114.5 deg included), outer pair 2|11 with margin 12. The ring sits on the outer-arc apex in all sections (offset +0.32 at the start, falling to -0.29 at the end, under 1 mm everywhere). Apex points cover s=-2 to 47 against a 46.9 mm line, edge to relief notch. The base dip next to this fold is a smooth roll with no crease (base profile figure, exaggerated vertical scale): local slope is about 8 deg at 5-8 mm, 4 deg at 8-12 mm, 2 deg at 12-18 mm and about 1 deg beyond, with a maximum dip of about 1.2 mm. It is fold-zone deformation, not a separate formed bend of 10 deg or more.
